title: A good fire fit is not enough: code and outputs
description: Analysis scripts, archived numerical records and digitised experimental-fire isochrones for the manuscript A good fire fit is not enough. Figure 3b uses 2,140 archived paired estimates; Figure 4 uses source CSIRO maps. PowerPoint layouts and the upstream raw dataset are supplied separately. No publication or DOI is claimed.
